sources.title: agenttune · PyPI
sources.snippet: AgentTune: build agentic workflows, then train, evaluate, distill, and self-heal them through one trajectory schema. A TRL-backed alignment + fine-tuning library (full RL coverage — DPO, PPO, GRPO) with an agentic integration spine on top: agent-design / memory-design / harness-design pillars, a Project lifecycle, and a FastAPI service.

sources.snippet: The domains are airline, retail and telecom. text-v1 and voice-v2 use the same 50 frozen tasks per domain in every language. voice-v1 is the English-only frame of the current English voice leaderboard (50 airline, 114 retail, 114 telecom tasks).
